content: W3C ARIA APG treeview pattern: role tree/treeitem/group; parents carry aria-expanded (never on leaves); dynamically loaded nodes need aria-level/aria-setsize/aria-posinset; multi-select trees use aria-checked and keyboard model Space toggles focused node, Shift+Arrow range toggles, asterisk expands all siblings, type-ahead recommended for trees with more than 7 root nodes; focus and selection are distinct; Select All/Unselect All buttons advised when select-all matters. Pattern leaves parent-child cascade propagation to the author but each node must accurately expose its own state.
